entry.title: SQ8LMPC 0.2.0
entry.summary: **SQ8LMPC 0.2.0**: SQ8L 0.91b (Ensoniq SQ-80 emulation by Siegfried Kullmann, based on sq8l-revival) for the Akai Force / MPC OS 3.x (ARMv7). Unofficial, free, non-commercial, for preservation only. **Bring your own ROM.** From this version the SQ-80 wave ROM and the SQ-80 factory sounds (bank D), both Ensoniq's, are not in the plugin.
